summary: Korro Bio, Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a press release announcing that the first cohort of participants has been dosed in ANCHOR, its Phase 1/2 clinical trial of KRRO-121, a GalNAc-conjugated RNA-editing oligonucleotide for hyperammonemia in urea cycle disorders and hepatic encephalopathy. A single 2 mg/kg dose was administered to healthy volunteers. The filing contains no transaction terms, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no change of control. It is a routine clinical milestone disclosure, not a special situation; there are no deal terms to monitor for risk arbitrage.
